benchmark.method: 2 warmups then sequential driver calls on reused connections; all result rows consumed. No HTTP, UI or LTA network time. Active sampling and caching may affect measurements.
benchmark.comparisonLimit: Different queries/data: these timings do not rank SQL against MongoDB.
benchmark.sqlExplainNote: Function Scan may hide internal PL/pgSQL plans. Inspect sql/002_queries.sql; this is not proof of an internal index scan.
